constraints.name: permutation_isomorphism_to_simple_hypercube
constraints.description: The permutation P must map the simple n-dimensional hypercube to the input graph, i.e., after relabeling vertices of the simple hypercube by P, the resulting edge set is identical to the input edge set.
constraints.formal: Let H be the simple n-dimensional hypercube. For (u,v) in E(H), (P[u],P[v]) must be an edge in the input graph, and the sets of edges coincide.

constraints.name: color_assignment_range
constraints.description: Each vertex color must be an integer between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

constraints.name: neighbor_color_completeness
constraints.description: For every vertex u and every color c, there must exist at least one neighbor v of u such that color(v) = c.
